output.question: What is Tilray's short interest?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Tilray Brands (TLRY) had 21.52 million shares sold short, equal to 14.67% of shares outstanding and 14.91% of its float [1](#cite-1). The short ratio was 5.15 days, and short interest was up from 18.79 million shares in the previous month [1](#cite-1).

key_facts.fact: Tilray Brands' latest short interest was 21.52 million shares.
Short interest represented 14.67% of shares outstanding and 14.91% of the float.
The short ratio was 5.15 days to cover, compared with 18.79 million shares short in the previous month.
